speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms better, can you tell me if the double vision and weakness fluctuate throughout the day, perhaps getting worse as the day progresses? Also, have you noticed any difficulty swallowing or changes in your speech?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any difficulty chewing or swallowing, or have you noticed your facial muscles becoming weaker, such as drooping eyelids? I will also request an Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody test to help confirm the suspicion.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had recent infections or fevers, and there is no family history of neurological disease. The weakness feels symmetrical in both arms and legs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any drooping eyelids or facial weakness that worsens later in the day? I will also request a Tensilon test to assess for reversible muscle weakness.

speaker: Patient
text: I have not had trouble swallowing or slurred speech. I also have not noticed breathing difficulty, and the symptoms started gradually about a month ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any drooping eyelids (ptosis) or facial weakness that worsens later in the day? I will also request a Tensilon test to assess for reversible muscle weakness.

speaker: Patient
text: The weakness is clearly worse with exertion and better after rest. I have not noticed muscle wasting or weight loss.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody_Test
REQUEST TEST: Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation_Test

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody_Test: Present (elevated); Repetitive_Nerve_Stimulation_Test: Decreased muscle response with repetitive stimulation

speaker: Doctor
text: The test results confirm the diagnosis of Myasthenia Gravis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
